subject: Performance qualification: next steps & benchmark harness
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Green <sam.green@brightcarve.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Performance qualification: next steps & benchmark harness

Hi Sam — great call this morning. Short recap and proposed next steps so we have an agreed path to qualification: 

Key targets you confirmed on the call:
- Latency SLOs: p50 <= 80ms, p95 <= 160ms (in-region; 95th measured across steady-state traffic)
- Throughput: baseline 120 req/s sustained for 30m windows; burst capacity to 250 req/s for short spikes
- Concurrency: 8 concurrent streams (chat sessions) per model instance
- Streaming: first-byte time for partial responses <= 50ms for streaming-enabled routes
- Accuracy/QoQ: you want minimal regression vs your current baseline (we'll correlate with your prompt set)

What we (Redwood) will provide for the run: 
- A reproducible harness (script + container) to run locally or in your test VPC; includes continuous-batching enabled scenarios and KV-cache warmup flows. See attached readme.
- A seed prompt set (attached: brightcarve-prompt-set.csv) that mirrors the call demo and the three priority flows you emphasized (search summarization, multi-turn booking, streaming transcriptions).
- Measurement definitions: per-request timing (first byte / last byte), token-level throughput, end-to-end cold vs warm latency, and p50/p95/p99 windows.

What we need from Brightcarve: 
- Finalized prompt set (please review the attached CSV and mark any variations you want included).
- Nativity constraints: confirm whether test traffic can originate from a Redwood-hosted region or must run from your VPC (you mentioned a preference for in-region runs for the first test).
- Any dataset redaction rules (PII filters) we should include in the harness.

Proposed timeline (tentative):
- Tue 9/21: share harness + prompt set (attached) — ACTION: Monica (done)
- Wed 9/22: Brightcarve review of prompts + environment decision — ACTION: Sam/Priya
- Thu 9/23 — Mon 9/27: run initial qualification (short runs + 1 sustained run) — ACTION: Redwood engineering (Aditya lead)
- Tue 9/28: sync and review results, agree on next gating (canary, config tweaks)

Please confirm the timeline and whether we should add any additional SLOs (eg token-cost limits or max-response-length limits). I attached the harness README and the seed prompt set; I can open a short Google Meet on Thu if you want to watch the run live.

Attachments: brightcarve-prompt-set.csv (12KB), redwood-benchmark-harness-readme.md (7KB)

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0179

Redwood Inference

From: Sam Green <sam.green@brightcarve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@brightcarve.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Performance qualification: next steps & benchmark harness

Thanks Monica — that matches our understanding. A few clarifications and constraints from our side:

1) Data residency: for the first pass, we prefer the test to originate from our us-west-2 VPC (we'll provide a temporary bastion + IAM roles). If that's not possible we can accept a Redwood-hosted run but only for quick smoke tests.
2) Streaming behaviour: our production consumers require incremental deltas for partial responses (we rely on token-level flushes). Can your harness capture first-byte token delays and token emission cadence?
3) Canary: we want a canary lane that ramps from 10% -> 50% over 30 minutes, with rollback on p95 > 200ms or error rate > 0.5%.
4) Security: attaching a short security checklist for vendor runs. Please confirm we can provide an interim SOC/attestation or point me to your SOC 2 report.

Attaching: brightcarve-security-checklist.pdf (3 pages)

On prompts: the attached seed is a great starting point. We will: 
- mark examples that map to our critical flows
- add 20 more heavy-long-context prompts (for cold-cache stress)

We can do the review by EOD Wed 9/22. If Redwood can draft the canary plan and the exact measurement log format (CSV/JSON schema) that will speed the run.

Sam
Head of AI Integrations | Brightcarve
sam.green@brightcarve.com

Internal notes / owner map for the Brightcarve run:

Summary of asks from Brightcarve:
- Run from Brightcarve us-west-2 VPC for the primary qualification run
- Instrument token-level emission times and first-byte latency for streaming responses
- Canary ramp + rollback thresholds (p95 > 200ms or errors > 0.5%)
- Security checklist requested (they attached a short doc)

Owners & plan:
- Aditya: own the harness deployment in their VPC (we'll provide a container image + terraform fragment). Ensure the harness supports both warm and cold starts and KV-cache warmup flows. Deliverable: harness container + runbook by Thu 9/23 EOD.
- Sean: draft the canary plan (ramp schedule + automated rollback rules) and the measurement schema (CSV with timestamp, request_id, first_byte_ms, last_byte_ms, tokens_out). Deliverable: canary plan + schema by Thu 9/23 noon.
- Monica: coordinate access, collect final prompt set from Sam, and schedule the Thu live run watch if they want.

Risks & mitigations:
- If they block outbound egress to our analytics, we'll run the harness with local collection and provide logs via secure Drive.
- Token emission instrumentation needs small runtime kernel hooks — will test on small instance first.

Next internal checkpoint: Thu 9/23 09:00 PST (internal sync) — please confirm availability.

Monica

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Performance qualification: next steps & benchmark harness

Thanks Sam & team — quick note to confirm we have the plan and the initial artifacts. Deliverables attached and links below.

What I pushed to the Brightcarve folder:
- redwood-benchmark-harness-readme.md (lightweight runbook + commands)
- harness container image: redwood/bench-harness:20260923 (we'll provide registry read creds)
- measurement schema (CSV/JSON) and a small synthetic-run example (sample_output.csv)

Proposed live run window: Fri 9/24 08:00-10:00 PST (short smoke + one sustained 30m run) — confirm if that works for you. If you prefer Thu evening PST we can try that too.

Quick notes on instrumentation for streaming token emission:
- The harness emits a per-token timestamp log (token_index, emitted_at_ms) and aggregates token emission cadence per-response. We map first-byte per-response and per-token inter-arrival times in the output CSV.
- For warm vs cold: we include a cache-warmup phase (100 warm requests) followed by cold restarts to capture cold-start tail latency.

Attachments/references: canary-plan-draft.pdf (attached), drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-brightcarve-bench

Next actions: Sam to confirm run window + provide final prompt set by EOD Thu 9/23. We'll stand up the harness in your VPC once we have the bastion details and temporary credentials.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
